title: The trial reminder, set on the phone

steps.label:
Subscribes with the free week.
Phone schedules a local notification.

"Your free week ends in 2 days.
Then $12.49 a month. Cancel any time."

example: Trial from 1 Oct: reminder 5 Oct at 10:00, charge 8 Oct
Cancelled on 3 Oct: the app sees it will not renew and drops the reminder
